plugin.name: Temporal Memory
plugin.description: Evidence-first layered temporal memory: verbatim quotes, automatic dormancy for events (90 d) and preferences (180 d), manual pin without decay, conflicts pending confirmation; no passive chat injection, pull-only recall.
plugin.short_description: Verbatim evidence + dormancy + conflict confirmation, pull-only recall.
entry.observe.name: Record a conversation turn
entry.observe.description: Store one turn in the plugin's private database and extract preferences/facts/events from the user's original words. No content is pushed into the chat.
entry.remember.name: Remember this
entry.remember.description: Write an anchor with verbatim evidence when the user explicitly asks to remember; pinned=true keeps it permanently.
entry.recall.name: Preview recall
entry.recall.description: Settings-page recall preview; hidden from the model.
entry.timeline.name: Read timeline
entry.timeline.description: Settings-page timeline view; hidden from the model.
entry.confirm_memory.name: Confirm memory
entry.confirm_memory.description: Confirm after checking the quote; refresh confirmation time and leave dormant/pending state.
entry.pin_memory.name: Pin memory
entry.pin_memory.description: Pinned memories never auto-sleep or decay.
entry.correct_memory.name: Correct memory
entry.correct_memory.description: Fix the summary, verbatim quote or type; undoable.
entry.archive_memory.name: Remove memory
entry.archive_memory.description: Remove from recall while keeping evidence and an undo record.
entry.resolve_conflict.name: Resolve conflict
entry.resolve_conflict.description: Keep one side of a pending conflict and archive the other.
entry.undo_last.name: Undo last action
entry.undo_last.description: Undo the latest panel correction, pin, removal or conflict resolution.
entry.export_memories.name: Export memories
entry.export_memories.description: Export all memories with verbatim evidence as JSON.
ui.title: Temporal Memory
ui.subtitle: Verbatim evidence + dormancy + conflict confirmation, no chat injection
ui.status.title: Memory status
ui.strategy.title: Writes and lifecycle
ui.strategy.disabled_hint: When disabled no new memory is written; existing memories can still be recalled.
ui.conflict.title: Pending conflicts
ui.conflict.hint: Both sides pause recall until one is adopted; the other is archived, and this is undoable.
ui.memory.title: Memories and evidence
ui.memory.empty: No memories yet. Enable writes and chat for a few turns.
ui.save.title: Save
ui.save.hint: Changes apply to this plugin's configuration only.
errors.not_ready: Memory engine is not ready yet; retry or reload the plugin
